payload.title: Publish: Amplify CDN keeps reader HTML for long (s-maxage=3600) and nothing purges it after the rebuild
payload.description: Found 2026-10-12. After a publish triggers a reader rebuild, the new build deploys but the CDN keeps serving the old HTML for up to s-maxage=3600; nothing invalidates it, so editors see their publish not take effect. Fix options: make sure the deployment invalidates (Amplify does for its own branch URL; verify for custom domains behind a separate CloudFront such as papyrus-edge-anth-us, which Amplify cannot invalidate and needs an explicit invalidation after the job), or lower the HTML s-maxage in customHttp.yml for Papyrus readers; document in docs/site-hosting.md.
